related.title: 同步輻射單色器
related.transfer: 可遷移「亮度、相空間與光束線接收度」與「鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；同步輻射單色器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance" and "Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Synchrotron monochromators must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從波盪器光源到樣品的相空間保存、掠射鏡、熱負載、斜率誤差、穩定度與 KB 奈米聚焦；同步輻射單色器則以Si(111) 雙晶單色器的布拉格角、Darwin 寬度、能量解析度、液氮冷卻與能量校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on phase-space preservation, grazing mirrors, heat load, slope error, stability and KB nanofocusing from undulator source to sample; Synchrotron monochromators centres on bragg angle, Darwin width, energy resolution, liquid-nitrogen cooling and energy calibration of a Si(111) double-crystal monochromator, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「波盪器光源點與相空間」與「白光入口與 Si(111) 第一晶體」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到同步輻射單色器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「能量解析度與強度穩定的誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Undulator source point and phase space” and “White-beam entrance and the first Si(111) crystal”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Synchrotron monochromators, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Error budget for energy resolution and intensity stability", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高亮度 X 光束線
history.text: 1948 年 Kirkpatrick 與 Baez 提出以兩面正交掠射鏡做 X 光成像，因當時鏡面加工精度不足而長期只是原理；1990 年代以波盪器為主的第三代同步輻射光源（ESRF、APS、SPring-8）讓亮度躍升數個數量級，鏡面斜率誤差與熱負載才成為光束線工程的核心課題，日本與歐美團隊也在 2000 年代把 KB 鏡推進到奈米聚焦。台灣光子源 TPS 為 3 GeV、發射度約 1.6 nm·rad 的儲存環，2014 年底首次出光，其蛋白質結晶學光束線即採用波盪器與 KB 聚焦。
history.textEn: In 1948 Kirkpatrick and Baez proposed X-ray imaging with two orthogonal grazing mirrors, an idea that stayed largely theoretical because mirror fabrication was not precise enough; third-generation undulator sources of the 1990s such as ESRF, APS and SPring-8 raised brilliance by orders of magnitude and made slope error and heat load central to beamline engineering, and Japanese, European and US teams pushed KB mirrors to nanofocusing in the 2000s. The Taiwan Photon Source is a 3 GeV ring with about 1.6 nm·rad emittance that saw first light at the end of 2014, and its protein-crystallography beamlines use undulators with KB focusing.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「亮度、相空間與光束線接收度」到「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance" through "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.

courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the components, measurements or system integration of High-brilliance X-ray beamlines. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement or endorsement.

vendors.businessEn: Operates the Taiwan Light Source and Taiwan Photon Source and designs, builds and commissions many X-ray beamlines in house.

vendors.businessEn: Swiss maker of hybrid photon-counting X-ray detectors widely used at synchrotron beamline endstations.

vendors.businessEn: Aerospace, defence and electronics group whose electron-device business produces high-power klystrons and other RF vacuum tubes for accelerators.
